purpose: Separate unchanged-vs-permuted tested joint from 120-vs-200 null training budget in an original toy neural DV implementation; not reproduce the external operational detector.

dataset.independent_units: 128 iid Gaussian pairs per dataset; no temporal dependence

estimator.objective: DV: mean critic on tested joint minus stabilized log mean exponential on product reference
estimator.normalization: joint/reference pooled column mean and standard deviation plus 1e-6, re-fit per call
implementation_departures: Original local NumPy implementation, no external modules executed/imported.
Correct standard one-time mean normalization of critic gradients; published backward also divides already normalized gradients by batch size, so this is not a faithful reproduction.
Two-dimensional Gaussian inputs rather than repository feature vectors.
Only DV branch; no NWJ, run-pair aggregation, sample-limit selection, plugin MI or other detector metrics.

pairing_controls: Same observed statistic reused across four cells.
Same marginal reference array used for retained/permuted tested-joint cells in each replicate.
Same null-network initialization and minibatch-index RNG for paired cells.
120 and 200 estimates read from same 200-step optimization trajectory.
Independent Y permutation for permuted tested joint; iid rows make row permutations admissible in this toy only.

p_value_diagnostics.gaussian_style: right-tail normal approximation of observed statistic relative to 3 null values, population variance floored at 1e-6, threshold0.05; not asserted valid
p_value_diagnostics.rank_style: (1+number(null>=observed))/(3+1), minimum0.25; no0.05 rejection possible, and source-style unequal estimator seeds prevent treating this as a validated exact randomization test

raw_score_calibration.status: Not performed; published raw-score calibration and ROC are separate from this toy.

report_metrics: PRIMARY: all raw per-dataset scores and three null estimates for every cell
PRIMARY: mean raw and null scores
PRIMARY: per-dataset paired budget and joint-construction contrasts
SECONDARY: Gaussian-style p<=0.05 score fractions with Wilson95% descriptive intervals, n=20 independent datasets per rho/cell
SECONDARY: rank-style minimum attainable p (0.25); not validated exact test
acceptance_criteria: Matched references byte-identical across paired cells
No success criterion requires a significant effect or a preferred rejection direction
prohibitions: No re-tuning or seed selection in response to outcomes
No external code execution or dependencies installed
No model APIs, paid compute, network training services or external communications
No actual-tool FPR, whole-pipeline or headline-paper claim
stopping_condition: Run all20 seeds per rho exactly once with declared hyperparameters. Finish after finite checks and tables. Record failures; never replace datasets or tune after outcomes.
